graphics_menu.doc: The Graphics settings page (M1-UI-10; docs/kb/tech/graphics_settings.md, 'The Graphics menu'). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference. 'page' are MenuPage metrics. value_keys: loc key per string option of graphics_presets.json 'settings' (booleans use on_key / off_key; numbers print as they are, except percent_settings, shown as a percentage, and multiplier_settings, shown with a times sign). The rows are the preset, then every setting in graphics_presets.json order. M2-UI-09: every settings page (SettingsPage: Graphics, Accessibility) and the Settings hub (SettingsMenu) share 'page', 'help' and 'backdrop_alpha', so they read as one family; the help line wraps to two lines; 'hub' canvas_layer is the hub's layer when the field menu opens it (over the field menu's 60 and the bestiary's 64).

speed_preview.doc: The Accessibility page's live preview of text speed and battle speed (SpeedPreview): right of the page, a caption, the sample, and for battle speed a pip that crosses track_px high in one action's hold; each loop holds hold_sec; pip_ease is the crossing's ease() curve.

controls.doc: The controls line under the help (the Lead's controller pass, 2026-10-30): how to move, change and go back.

apply.doc: M1-UI-11: a preset change with GraphicsRuntime armed spawns the resident shader warm-up (a frame can freeze 0.5-1.7 s), so the page fades to an opaque veil over fade_out_sec, lets settle_frames opaque frames draw, selects the preset, holds card_key until the warm-up is done (max_hold_sec is a safety net), then fades back over fade_in_sec. Input is blocked throughout. card.rect is x, y, w, h at 1920 x 1080.
